---
title: "Adjacency Matrix"
subtitle: "See how a graph becomes a grid of 0s and 1s"
---

## 1. One row at a time

Select a node on the graph below. The header lists every node in the graph,
and the single row underneath shows a 1 where that node connects to the
column's node, and a 0 otherwise. The selected node's own column is tinted
so you can see where the row and column would cross in the full matrix.

```{python}
#| echo: false
w1_nodes = [
    {"id": "A", "label": "A"},
    {"id": "B", "label": "B"},
    {"id": "C", "label": "C"},
]
w1_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "A", "target": "B", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "A", "target": "C", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(m1_nodes = w1_nodes, m1_edges = w1_edges)
```

::: {.widget-block}
::: {.panel-grid}
::: {.panel}
<div id="am1-graph"></div>
:::
::: {.panel}
<div id="am1-matrix"></div>
:::
:::
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { GraphEngine } from "./js/graph-engine.js";
import { mountGraphView } from "./js/graph-view.js";
import { mountAdjacencyMatrixSingle } from "./js/adjacency-matrix-view.js";

am1Engine = new GraphEngine({ nodes: m1_nodes, edges: m1_edges }, { directed: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mountGraphView(am1Engine, document.querySelector("#am1-graph"), { width: 460, height: 380 });
mountAdjacencyMatrixSingle(am1Engine, document.querySelector("#am1-matrix"));
```

## 2. The full adjacency matrix

Now the whole N x N matrix is shown. The row and column of the selected
node are both tinted; selecting an edge highlights its exact cell(s). Try
adding a node and watch the grid grow by one row and one column.

```{python}
#| echo: false
w2_nodes = [
    {"id": "A", "label": "A"},
    {"id": "B", "label": "B"},
    {"id": "C", "label": "C"},
    {"id": "D", "label": "D"},
]
w2_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "A", "target": "B", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "A", "target": "C", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e2", "source": "B", "target": "D", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e3", "source": "C", "target": "D", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(m2_nodes = w2_nodes, m2_edges = w2_edges)
```

::: {.widget-block}
::: {.panel-grid}
::: {.panel}
<div id="am2-graph"></div>
:::
::: {.panel}
<div id="am2-matrix"></div>
:::
:::
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { mountAdjacencyMatrix } from "./js/adjacency-matrix-view.js";

am2Engine = new GraphEngine({ nodes: m2_nodes, edges: m2_edges }, { directed: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mountGraphView(am2Engine, document.querySelector("#am2-graph"), { width: 460, height: 380 });
mountAdjacencyMatrix(am2Engine, document.querySelector("#am2-matrix"));
```
